projects.title: Kinescope - Full-Stack Video Platform with AI Agents
projects.description: Built a full-stack YouTube-style platform - React, Node/Express, MongoDB - with Cloudinary video upload, comments, subscriptions, and playlists; deployed on Render with GitHub CI/CD. Designed 2 LangGraph AI agents on Gemini: a RAG-based recommendation engine grounded in a user's real watch/like history, and a hallucination-safe video-chat assistant that answers only from retrieved video metadata. Live demo available.

projects.title: Adaptive RAG Chatbot (Agentic AI, Full-Stack)
projects.description: Built an agentic RAG chatbot using LangGraph that classifies each query with an LLM and dynamically routes it to document retrieval, general knowledge, or live web search (Tavily API). Designed a self-correcting retrieval pipeline with LLM-based relevance grading and automatic query rewriting on low-relevance results, backed by a FAISS vector store and Groq-hosted LLMs. Deployed a full-stack production app (FastAPI backend on Render, Streamlit frontend on Streamlit Cloud) with persistent, session-based chat history in MongoDB Atlas. Live demo available.

projects.title: LearnMind - AI-Assisted E-Learning Platform (Backend)
projects.description: Built a full-stack, AI-assisted e-learning platform with role-based authentication; integrated the Gemini API for an adaptive assessment engine generating personalized exams and an AI tutoring chatbot. Designed student diagnostic dashboards for real-time performance insights and added Socket.IO notifications to boost engagement. Live demo available.

Applied industry-standard coding and design practices on live production web projects, improving consistency and maintainability of delivered code. Used Git-based workflows and participated in regular code reviews, contributing to improved code quality and reduced defect rates.
